title: How to update the phone number on your account
description: An accurate and up-to-date phone number is an important step you can take toward improved account security.

crumbs.title: How to update the phone number on your account

runs: Follow the prompt to update your phone number on the keypad.
Note: To delete your current number, tap Phone number, select Delete number, then tap Yes, delete to confirm.
